methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected from each vendor's official site where accessible. SimpliSafe, Ring Alarm, ADT, Vivint, Cove, and Frontpoint either blocked automated access (403/404) or render pricing behind JS builders; their figures were sourced from reputable 2026 pricing-comparison sources (safewise.com and bobvila.com) and cross-corroborated between the two. Abode's official pricing page (goabode.com/plans) rendered live and was read directly. For home-security products, monthlyUsd = the recurring monitoring fee; one-time equipment/hardware costs are recorded in setupFeeUsd and notes. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null throughout (non-telephony vertical). Quote-only or contact-sales tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null.

vendors.name: SimpliSafe
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page simplisafe.com blocked automated access; pricing sourced from safewise.com and security.org SimpliSafe cost pages (2026). Verified 2026-06-14: Self-Monitoring with Video $9.99, Standard $22.80, Pro $49.99, Pro Plus $79.99 all corroborated. plans.name: Self-Monitoring (No Video)

plans.name: Self-Monitoring with Video

plans.name: Standard

plans.name: Pro

vendors.name: Abode

Annual prices cross-checked against goabode.com/security-plans (which returned same figures). Corroborated by safewise.com/best-home-security-systems.

plans.name: No Subscription
plans.notes: Full app access, live video streaming, push notifications, smart home integrations (Apple HomeKit, Alexa, Google Home). No professional monitoring. Free forever. Equipment sold separately.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Month-to-month $8.49/mo; annual $79.99/yr (~$6.67/mo, ~21% savings). Adds 30-day event history, AI smart detection, rich notifications, insurance discount eligibility. Self-monitoring only — no professional dispatch. No contract.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Month-to-month $26.99/mo; annual $245.99/yr (~$20.50/mo, ~24% savings). Adds 24/7 professional monitoring, 4G cellular backup, automatic emergency dispatch. Up to 30% insurance discount. No contract.

plans.name: On-Demand (3-Day)
plans.notes: One-time purchase of 3 days of professional monitoring for $8. Not a recurring subscription — priced as a one-time activation. Available to users on the No Subscription or Standard tier.

plans.name: On-Demand (7-Day)
plans.notes: One-time purchase of 7 days of professional monitoring for $15. Not a recurring subscription. Available to users on the No Subscription or Standard tier.
